summary: Tested newsletter improvements (HTML editor, recipient selection, scheduling) and 3MF multi-slicer parser. Backend: 13/13 pytest tests passed. Frontend: all 10 newsletter testids verified, recipient selection (16 users found), search filter, bold/HTML editor, preview, mode toggle, schedule fields all functional.

issues: Date/time inputs use browser-native <input type='date'> and <input type='time'> (mm/dd/yyyy format) instead of shadcn Calendar+Popover component. Inconsistent with the rest of the dark UI and shows in US date format despite Italian locale.

passed_tests: GET /api/admin/users returns user list (used for recipient picker)
GET /api/admin/newsletters returns list
POST /api/admin/newsletters creates HTML newsletter to all verified users (is_html=true, recipient_ids=[])
POST /api/admin/newsletters creates plain-text newsletter to specific recipient_ids (count=1)
POST /api/admin/newsletters with scheduled_at returns status='scheduled' and persists
DELETE /api/admin/newsletters/{id} deletes scheduled newsletter
Newsletter history endpoint returns subject + body so frontend can strip HTML for preview
POST /api/admin/newsletters returns 401/403 without auth
POST /api/import/3mf requires authentication (401/403)
POST /api/import/3mf rejects non-.3mf files (400)
POST /api/import/3mf parses Bambu plate JSON (Metadata/plate_*.json) - time=9300s, filament=35.7g
POST /api/import/3mf parses Creality Print PrintTicket.xml - time=7200s, weight=30.5g (BUG FIX VERIFIED)
POST /api/import/3mf falls back to gcode comments (;TIME:9185, ;Filament Weight:25.58)
POST /api/import/3mf returns 400 for empty .3mf with no slicer data

Frontend: Pannello -> Newsletter tab loads with all 10 testids (newsletter-subject, recipients-all-btn, recipients-selected-btn, mode-html-btn, mode-text-btn, editor-toolbar, newsletter-editor, preview-btn, newsletter-schedule-toggle, send-newsletter-btn)
Frontend: 'Tutti (16)' button shows 16 user count from real DB; 'Seleziona' button reveals checkbox list with 16 users
Frontend: Recipient search filter works (search 'testuser' -> 1 result)
Frontend: HTML editor execCommand('bold') wraps text in ...
Frontend: 'Mostra Anteprima' renders HTML preview with formatted content
Frontend: Mode toggle Formattato <-> Testo Semplice swaps editor for textarea ([data-testid='newsletter-body'])
Frontend: 'Programma invio' checkbox reveals date+time inputs
Frontend: Newsletter history list shows 3 items with status badges
action_items: (Optional/low priority) Replace browser-native <input type='date'>/<input type='time'> in Newsletter scheduler with shadcn Calendar + Popover for visual consistency and Italian dd/mm/yyyy format.
(Optional code review) document.execCommand is deprecated. Functional today in all major browsers but consider migrating to a maintained rich-text library (TipTap, Lexical) for long-term reliability.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 2170 lines - approaching threshold; consider splitting into routers (auth, admin, products, public, import) for maintainability.

Newsletter send loop is synchronous in request handler (line 1471): for large recipient lists this will block the request. Consider running send loop as background task (BackgroundTasks) for the 'send now' branch as well, similar to how scheduler works.

_parse_3mf_zip Strategy 4 (XML model metadata) - condition 'time' in attr_name and ('print' in attr_name or 'estimated' in attr_name) may miss Creality Print attributes named just 'PrintTime' (lowercase 'print' check still matches but worth a unit test).
seed_data_creation: Created 2 'sent' newsletters (TEST_HTML, TEST_TARGETED Plain) in DB during testing - they remain in storico. The TEST_SCHEDULED newsletter was deleted during the test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Newsletter feature fully working: (1) is_html flag triggers send_html_email; (2) recipient_ids targets specific users (or [] for all verified); (3) scheduled_at sets status='scheduled' and background scheduler (60s loop) sends them; (4) NewsletterTab in AdminPanelPage uses contentEditable + document.execCommand for B/I/U/H2/H3/lists/link/color/removeFormat. Test users: 16 in DB. 3MF parser tested with synthetic Bambu plate JSON, Creality PrintTicket.xml, and gcode-comments .3mf files - all 5 strategies covered. We did not test Strategy 2 (slice_info.config) and Strategy 4 (XML model metadata) explicitly but their code paths exist; Bambu/Creality/gcode strategies cover the user-reported bug. Real .3mf upload from real Creality Print/Bambu Studio output not tested (no real files available).
